planner_roles.narration_performance: an assured on-screen movie analyst narrating a reasoned alternate encounter through specific character decisions and consequences

performance_directives: Follow the approved scenario's action, counterplay and payoff with natural, measured conviction. Embed the opinion in the reasoned outcome; do not add audience questions, filler or repeated first-person opinion announcements.
Keep film evidence, the changed assumption and invented outcomes distinct. Confidence in our authored scenario is not certainty about unreleased film events or unproven powers.
Preserve the owned Joel voice and exact approved words. Delivery intent remains metadata; do not pretend Qwen Base supports performance tags or speed controls.
